messages.content: What is the Memory System module?

The Memory System (id: mem) is one of Jarvis's core modules. It provides 6 API endpoints. POST /api/memory/memorize-event with body { 'description': 'User completed login flow', 'importance': 'medium' }. Returns { status: 'memorized' }.
How do I use the GET /api/memory endpoint?
GET /api/memory: Return core memory: user profile + current context. Headers: x-user-id.
How do I use the POST /api/memory/update-profile endpoint?
POST /api/memory/update-profile: Update user profile. Body: { name, alias, age, job, interests, location, mission }
How do I use the POST /api/memory/sync-profile endpoint?
POST /api/memory/sync-profile: Sync profile from external source. Body: { profile }
How do I use the POST /api/memory/memorize-event endpoint?
POST /api/memory/memorize-event: Store episodic memory. Body: { description, importance (low/medium/high) }
How do I use the POST /api/memory/add-relation endpoint?
POST /api/memory/add-relation: Add semantic relation. Body: { source, target, label }
How do I use the POST /api/memory/import-okf endpoint?
POST /api/memory/import-okf: Import Open Knowledge Format data. Body: { okf_data }
How do I store a memory?
POST /api/memory/memorize-event with body { 'description': 'User completed login flow', 'importance': 'medium' }. Returns { status: 'memorized' }.
What's in my core memory?
GET /api/memory returns the user profile (name, alias, age, job, location, mission, interests, birth_date) and current conversation context. Profile is persisted to jarvis_core_memory.json.
How do I add a knowledge relationship?
POST /api/memory/add-relation with body { 'source': 'JarvisOS', 'target': 'TRMSwarm', 'label': 'integrates_with' }. Adds a directed semantic edge to the knowledge graph.
What errors can occur in the Memory System module?
Errors: 400 if required fields missing, 500 on file I/O failure
How does the Memory System module integrate with other Jarvis modules?
Memory feeds into Chat (context generation), Semantic Graph (knowledge persistence), and Episodic Memory (event recall).
What is the Chat System module?

The Chat System (id: chat) is one of Jarvis's core modules. It provides 3 API endpoints. POST /api/chat with body { 'message': 'Hello Jarvis', 'userId': 'shawn' }. Returns { reply: '...' }. The message goes through runJarvisAgent which calls Google Gemini AI with system prompt, conversational history, and optional visual data.
How do I use the POST /api/chat endpoint?
POST /api/chat: Main AI chat. Body: { message, history?, visualData?, userId?, accessToken? }. Returns: { reply }
How do I use the GET /api/chat-history endpoint?
GET /api/chat-history: Return chat history. Headers: x-user-id. Returns: [{ id, role, content, timestamp }]
How do I use the POST /api/chat-history/clear endpoint?
POST /api/chat-history/clear: Clear chat history. Headers: x-user-id.
How do I chat with you?

POST /api/chat with body { 'message': 'Hello Jarvis', 'userId': 'shawn' }. Returns { reply: '...' }. The message goes through runJarvisAgent which calls Google Gemini AI with system prompt, conversational history, and optional visual data.
What happens when the Gemini API quota is exhausted?

The chat handler detects 429/RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED errors and returns: 'My apologies, Boss. It appears my core thinking matrix has exhausted the Gemini API's free request quota. Standing by on standby power.'
How does chat context work?
Chat loads core memory for user profile, then retrieves chat history (up to 50 messages), and sends the full context to the AI model for generation.
What errors can occur in the Chat System module?
Errors: 400 if no message, 500 on API failure (with graceful error reply), 429 when Gemini quota exhausted
How does the Chat System module integrate with other Jarvis modules?
Chat reads Memory for context, writes to Chat History, and can trigger Skills, Swarm Delegation, and Web Analysis.
What is the Skills System module?

The Skills System (id: skills) is one of Jarvis's core modules. It provides 5 API endpoints. I have 9 skills: GitHub Code Auditor (core security scanner), Web Oracle Grounding (utility web search), Telegram Uplink Bot Matrix (integration messaging), System Optimizer (automation performance), Open Design Studio (integration creative), Biomimetic Science Research Hub (science biology), Career & Job Matching Assistant (automation jobs), Resonant Memory Graph Sync (core knowledge), TRM Swarm OS Mesh Controller (integration distributed agents).
How do I use the GET /api/skills endpoint?
GET /api/skills: List all skills from jarvis_skills.json.
How do I use the POST /api/skills/toggle endpoint?
POST /api/skills/toggle: Enable/disable a skill. Body: { skillId }
How do I use the POST /api/skills/add endpoint?
POST /api/skills/add: Register a new skill. Body: { name, description, category, icon? }
How do I use the GET /api/skills/matrix endpoint?
GET /api/skills/matrix: Get skill matrix from TRM swarm (proxied).
How do I use the GET /api/skills/matrix/topology endpoint?
GET /api/skills/matrix/topology: Get skill topology from TRM swarm (proxied).
What skills do you have?

I have 9 skills: GitHub Code Auditor (core security scanner), Web Oracle Grounding (utility web search), Telegram Uplink Bot Matrix (integration messaging), System Optimizer (automation performance), Open Design Studio (integration creative), Biomimetic Science Research Hub (science biology), Career & Job Matching Assistant (automation jobs), Resonant Memory Graph Sync (core knowledge), TRM Swarm OS Mesh Controller (integration distributed agents).
How do I register a new skill?
POST /api/skills/add with body { 'name': 'MySkill', 'description': 'Does X', 'category': 'utility', 'icon': 'Star' }. The skill is added to jarvis_skills.json and becomes available for the AI to use.
How do I enable/disable a skill?
POST /api/skills/toggle with body { 'skillId': 'web_grounding' }. The skill's 'enabled' flag toggles. Disabled skills are hidden from the AI's tool selection.
What errors can occur in the Skills System module?
Errors: 400 if skillId missing for toggle, 400 if name/description missing for add
How does the Skills System module integrate with other Jarvis modules?
Skills are read by the Chat system to determine capabilities. Skills Matrix proxies to TRM swarm. Skills persist to jarvis_skills.json.
What is the TRM Swarm Integration module?

The TRM Swarm Integration (id: swarm) is one of Jarvis's core modules. It provides 6 API endpoints. Jarvis proxies to TRM at 127.0.0.1:8021 (not localhost). It announces itself as 'jarvis_gateway' on the mesh. It syncs topology, skills matrix, healing status, and can delegate tasks to 12 core agents.
How do I use the POST /api/swarm/intent/predict endpoint?
POST /api/swarm/intent/predict: Predict swarm intent. Body: { user_input, context? }. Proxies to TRM /swarm/intent/predict.
How do I use the POST /api/swarm/intent/record endpoint?
POST /api/swarm/intent/record: Record user intent. Body: { intent_data }.
How do I use the POST /api/swarm/spatial/feed endpoint?
POST /api/swarm/spatial/feed: Send spatial telemetry. Body: { telemetry }.
How do I use the GET /api/swarm/spatial/ambient endpoint?
GET /api/swarm/spatial/ambient: Get ambient spatial state from TRM.
How do I use the GET /api/swarm/healing/status endpoint?
GET /api/swarm/healing/status: Get swarm healing status from TRM. Returns: { agent_health_scores, degraded_agents, healing_active }
How do I use the POST /api/swarm/healing/force-reassign endpoint?
POST /api/swarm/healing/force-reassign: Force skill reassignment. Body: { role, target_role? }.
How does Jarvis communicate with the TRM swarm?

Jarvis proxies to TRM at 127.0.0.1:8021 (not localhost). It announces itself as 'jarvis_gateway' on the mesh. It syncs topology, skills matrix, healing status, and can delegate tasks to 12 core agents.
How do I check swarm health through Jarvis?
GET /api/swarm/healing/status proxies to TRM's /swarm/healing/status. Returns active nodes, health scores per agent, degraded agents list, and total tasks tracked.
What's the spatial mesh?

The spatial mesh (/api/swarm/spatial/ambient, /api/swarm/spatial/feed) tracks agent entanglements and state projections in the TRM's spatial entanglement system. It's used for the dashboard's Spatial Mesh visualization.
What errors can occur in the TRM Swarm Integration module?
Errors: 502 if TRM unreachable (ECONNREFUSED), Timeout after 1000ms on topology fetch
How does the TRM Swarm Integration module integrate with other Jarvis modules?
Connects to TRM Swarm OS v2 on port 8021. DNA config pushes temp/stochasticity. Mesh registration, intent sync, healing status, skill matrix.
What is the Career & Job Matching module?

The Career & Job Matching (id: jobs) is one of Jarvis's core modules. It provides 6 API endpoints. GET /api/jobs/recommendations returns personalized job listings. POST /api/jobs/match with your profile and skills returns ranked matches. The system scrapes Remotive (GET /api/jobs/remotive) for live global job feeds.
How do I use the GET /api/jobs/recommendations endpoint?
GET /api/jobs/recommendations: Get personalized job recommendations.
How do I use the POST /api/jobs/match endpoint?
POST /api/jobs/match: Match user to jobs. Body: { profile, skills? }
How do I use the GET /api/jobs/remotive endpoint?
GET /api/jobs/remotive: Scrape Remotive job feed.
How do I use the GET /api/jobs endpoint?
GET /api/jobs: List all jobs.
How do I use the POST /api/jobs endpoint?
POST /api/jobs: Create a job entry. Body: { title, company, url, description? }
How do I use the POST /api/jobs/sync endpoint?
POST /api/jobs/sync: Sync job database with external sources.
How does job matching work?

GET /api/jobs/recommendations returns personalized job listings. POST /api/jobs/match with your profile and skills returns ranked matches. The system scrapes Remotive (GET /api/jobs/remotive) for live global job feeds.
What errors can occur in the Career & Job Matching module?
Errors: 500 on scrape failure
How does the Career & Job Matching module integrate with other Jarvis modules?
Reads skills from Skills System for matching. Persists to jobs database.
What is the Telegram Uplink module?

The Telegram Uplink (id: telegram) is one of Jarvis's core modules. It provides 2 API endpoints. POST /api/telegram/config with body { 'botToken': 'YOUR_BOT_TOKEN' }. This turns on the Telegram uplink skill automatically and starts the polling daemon. Check status with GET /api/telegram/status.
How do I use the POST /api/telegram/config endpoint?
POST /api/telegram/config: Configure Telegram. Body: { botToken }. Also sets env TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN.
How do I use the GET /api/telegram/status endpoint?
GET /api/telegram/status: Get Telegram polling status. Returns: { polling, botUsername, lastUpdateId? }
How do I set up Telegram?
POST /api/telegram/config with body { 'botToken': 'YOUR_BOT_TOKEN' }. This turns on the Telegram uplink skill automatically and starts the polling daemon. Check status with GET /api/telegram/status.
How does Telegram polling work?
A background daemon polls Telegram API for updates every 2 seconds. New messages are dispatched back to the chat interface and relayed to the AI for response.
What errors can occur in the Telegram Uplink module?
Errors: 400 if no botToken, 401 on invalid bot token during config
How does the Telegram Uplink module integrate with other Jarvis modules?
Auto-enables Telegram skill. Polling daemon runs as background process in the server. Messages flow through Chat system.
What is the VibeThinker Consensus Engine module?

The VibeThinker Consensus Engine (id: vibethinker) is one of Jarvis's core modules. It provides 2 API endpoints. VibeThinker is a claim-level reliability (CLR) consensus evaluation system. It runs multiple AI trajectories on the same prompt (default 3 samples) using Ollama models (default deepseek-r1:1.5b), and evaluates consensus across responses. It provides a reliability score. VibeThinker-1.5B and 3B are open-source models from WeiboAI.
How do I use the POST /api/vibe/consensus endpoint?
POST /api/vibe/consensus: Simple VibeThinker evaluation. Body: { prompt, model?, voltage? }
How do I use the POST /api/vibe-thinker/consensus endpoint?
POST /api/vibe-thinker/consensus: Multi-trajectory VibeThinker. Body: { prompt, model?, numSamples? }
What is VibeThinker?

VibeThinker is a claim-level reliability (CLR) consensus evaluation system. It runs multiple AI trajectories on the same prompt (default 3 samples) using Ollama models (default deepseek-r1:1.5b), and evaluates consensus across responses. It provides a reliability score. VibeThinker-1.5B and 3B are open-source models from WeiboAI.
How do I run VibeThinker consensus?
POST /api/vibe-thinker/consensus with body { 'prompt': 'Analyze this claim', 'model': 'deepseek-r1:1.5b', 'numSamples': 3 }. Returns { trajectories: [...], consensusScore, aggregatedResponse }.
What's the difference between /api/vibe/consensus and /api/vibe-thinker/consensus?

/api/vibe/consensus is the simple evaluation (single pass, optional voltage parameter). /api/vibe-thinker/consensus is the full multi-trajectory engine that runs multiple parallel Ollama calls, collects trajectories, and computes a consensus score.
What errors can occur in the VibeThinker Consensus Engine module?
Errors: 400 if no prompt, 502 if Ollama unreachable
How does the VibeThinker Consensus Engine module integrate with other Jarvis modules?
Calls Ollama API (localhost:11434) for model inference. Uses deepseek-r1:1.5b by default. Trajectories feed into decision-making.
What is the Noospheric Calibration module?

The Noospheric Calibration (id: noospheric) is one of Jarvis's core modules. It provides 2 API endpoints. It's a bio-inspired cognitive health model with parameters: activeVector (e.g. 'utp'), methylationProgress (0-100), chromatinAccessibility (0-100), bCellAblationPercent, cytokineStormRisk (0-100), epigeneticPrimingActive, cfDNALevel, ifnAlphaLevel, vagusNerveStatus (IDLE/ACTIVE), haloIntegrity (0-100), engineType (xenobiotic), xenobioticDigestionRate, repairRateMultiplier, zeroDayImmunityLoaded.
How do I use the GET /api/noospheric/status endpoint?
GET /api/noospheric/status: Return noospheric calibration state.
How do I use the POST /api/noospheric/status endpoint?
POST /api/noospheric/status: Update noospheric calibration. Body: { activeVector, methylationProgress, chromatinAccessibility, cytokineStormRisk, vagusNerveStatus, xenobioticDigestionRate }
What is the noospheric calibration system?

It's a bio-inspired cognitive health model with parameters: activeVector (e.g. 'utp'), methylationProgress (0-100), chromatinAccessibility (0-100), bCellAblationPercent, cytokineStormRisk (0-100), epigeneticPrimingActive, cfDNALevel, ifnAlphaLevel, vagusNerveStatus (IDLE/ACTIVE), haloIntegrity (0-100), engineType (xenobiotic), xenobioticDigestionRate, repairRateMultiplier, zeroDayImmunityLoaded.
How do I check my noospheric state?
GET /api/noospheric/status returns all calibration parameters as a JSON object. It's persisted to jarvis_noospheric_calibration.json.
How does the Noospheric Calibration module integrate with other Jarvis modules?
Noospheric state influences Chat personality. Used by the dashboard's Status panel.
What is the Biomimetic Science & Presets module?

The Biomimetic Science & Presets (id: biomimetic) is one of Jarvis's core modules. It provides 3 API endpoints. Biologically-inspired behavioral configuration states. Each preset encodes neural oscillation frequency, synaptic plasticity levels, neurotransmitter balance, and other bio-inspired parameters that shape AI response profiles.
How do I use the GET /api/biomimetic/presets endpoint?
GET /api/biomimetic/presets: List biomimetic presets from jarvis_biomimetic_presets.json.
How do I use the POST /api/biomimetic/presets endpoint?
POST /api/biomimetic/presets: Update biomimetic presets. Body: { presets }
How do I use the POST /api/biomimetic endpoint?
POST /api/biomimetic: Run biomimetic simulation. Body: { type, params? }
What are biomimetic presets?

Biologically-inspired behavioral configuration states. Each preset encodes neural oscillation frequency, synaptic plasticity levels, neurotransmitter balance, and other bio-inspired parameters that shape AI response profiles.
How do I use biomimetic simulations?
POST /api/biomimetic with body { 'type': 'alphafold', 'params': { 'sequence': 'MVLSPADKTNVKAAW...' } }. This triggers AlphaFold/AlphaGenome structure prediction through the Substrate Agent Platform.
What errors can occur in the Biomimetic Science & Presets module?
Errors: 400 if type missing
How does the Biomimetic Science & Presets module integrate with other Jarvis modules?
Biomimetic presets feed into Chat personality modulation. Simulations call the Substrate Agent Platform.
What is the Web Intelligence Analyzer module?

The Web Intelligence Analyzer (id: webanalyzer) is one of Jarvis's core modules. It provides 1 API endpoints. POST /api/web-analyzer with body { 'url': 'example.com' }. It runs: DNS resolution, TLS certificate check, WHOIS lookup (via urllib), content scraping, and optional headless browser rendering. Returns a comprehensive security and content analysis report.
How do I use the POST /api/web-analyzer endpoint?
POST /api/web-analyzer: Analyze a web domain. Body: { url }. Checks DNS, TLS, WHOIS, headless browser rendering, and scrapes content.
How do I analyze a website?

POST /api/web-analyzer with body { 'url': 'example.com' }. It runs: DNS resolution, TLS certificate check, WHOIS lookup (via urllib), content scraping, and optional headless browser rendering. Returns a comprehensive security and content analysis report.
What analysis does the web analyzer perform?

It checks: HTTPS availability, TLS certificate validity (dates, issuer, subject), DNS resolution, domain WHOIS info (registrar, creation date), headless browser page rendering, content extraction, and subdomain enumeration.
What errors can occur in the Web Intelligence Analyzer module?
Errors: 400 if no URL, 500 on DNS/TLS failure
How does the Web Intelligence Analyzer module integrate with other Jarvis modules?
Results can be stored as episodic memories. Used by Web Oracle Grounding skill.
What is the System & Health module?

The System & Health (id: system) is one of Jarvis's core modules. It provides 2 API endpoints. GET /api/system-stats returns: platform, CPU cores, memory usage, uptime, hostname, and load average. Useful for monitoring system health.
How do I use the GET /api/system-stats endpoint?
GET /api/system-stats: Return system resource stats (CPU, memory, uptime, etc.).
How do I use the POST /api/execute-cmd endpoint?
POST /api/execute-cmd: Execute shell command. Body: { command }. Returns: { stdout, stderr, exitCode }
How do I check system stats?
GET /api/system-stats returns: platform, CPU cores, memory usage, uptime, hostname, and load average. Useful for monitoring system health.
Can I run shell commands through Jarvis?
POST /api/execute-cmd with body { 'command': 'ls -la' }. Returns { stdout: '...', stderr: '', exitCode: 0 }. This is a privileged operation.
What errors can occur in the System & Health module?
Errors: 400 if no command, 500 on execution failure
How does the System & Health module integrate with other Jarvis modules?
Feeds into System Optimizer skill. Stats shown on dashboard.
What is the DNA Behavioral Configuration module?

The DNA Behavioral Configuration (id: dna) is one of Jarvis's core modules. It provides 1 API endpoints. POST /config/dna updates my dynamic behavioral parameters. This is called by the TRM swarm's digital_dna_loop to push refraction parameters: temperature (response creativity), stochasticity (randomness), emotionalVector (mood bias), and curiosity (exploration drive).
How do I use the POST /config/dna endpoint?
POST /config/dna: Update dynamic behavioral parameters (Phase B Refraction). Body: { temperature?, stochasticity?, emotionalVector?, mood?, curiosity? }
What is the DNA configuration endpoint?

POST /config/dna updates my dynamic behavioral parameters. This is called by the TRM swarm's digital_dna_loop to push refraction parameters: temperature (response creativity), stochasticity (randomness), emotionalVector (mood bias), and curiosity (exploration drive).
How does the TRM swarm update my personality?
TRM's digital_dna_loop.py calls POST /config/dna on port 3000 with temperature and stochasticity values. This adjusts my cognitive state in real-time based on swarm telemetry.
How does the DNA Behavioral Configuration module integrate with other Jarvis modules?
Primary integration point between TRM swarm and Jarvis. DNA values are stored in memory and affect chat temperature and response generation.
What is the Asciline Processor module?

The Asciline Processor (id: asciline) is one of Jarvis's core modules. It provides 1 API endpoints. POST /api/asciline/process with body { 'input': 'your data' }. Asciline is an ascending/linear processing pipeline for transforming and categorizing input data through structured stages.
How do I use the POST /api/asciline/process endpoint?
POST /api/asciline/process: Process asciline input. Body: { input, format? }
What is Asciline processing?
POST /api/asciline/process with body { 'input': 'your data' }. Asciline is an ascending/linear processing pipeline for transforming and categorizing input data through structured stages.
What errors can occur in the Asciline Processor module?
Errors: 400 if no input
How does the Asciline Processor module integrate with other Jarvis modules?
Processed output can feed into Semantic Graph or Episodic Memory.
What is the Resource Learning module?

The Resource Learning (id: learn) is one of Jarvis's core modules. It provides 1 API endpoints. POST /api/learn-resource with body { 'url': 'https://docs.example.com/api', 'format': 'markdown' }. Jarvis ingests the content and stores it in the semantic graph for future recall.
How do I use the POST /api/learn-resource endpoint?
POST /api/learn-resource: Learn from a resource. Body: { url?, text?, format? }
How do I teach Jarvis something new?
POST /api/learn-resource with body { 'url': 'https://docs.example.com/api', 'format': 'markdown' }. Jarvis ingests the content and stores it in the semantic graph for future recall.
What errors can occur in the Resource Learning module?
Errors: 400 if no url or text
How does the Resource Learning module integrate with other Jarvis modules?
Learned resources are stored in Semantic Graph memory.
What is the Substrate Agent Platform module?

The Substrate Agent Platform (id: substrate) is one of Jarvis's core modules. It runs as a background system. The Substrate Agent Platform (substrate_agent_platform.py) is a Python background system that orchestrates multi-agent consensus loops, triggers biomimetic simulations (AlphaFold/AlphaGenome), queries the semantic memory graph, and updates persistent databases. It runs autonomously without direct user intervention.
What is the Substrate Agent Platform?

The Substrate Agent Platform (substrate_agent_platform.py) is a Python background system that orchestrates multi-agent consensus loops, triggers biomimetic simulations (AlphaFold/AlphaGenome), queries the semantic memory graph, and updates persistent databases. It runs autonomously without direct user intervention.
What does the Substrate Platform do autonomously?

It runs scheduled tasks like: genome sequence analysis, protein structure prediction via AlphaFold, semantic graph maintenance, noospheric calibration checks, and scheduled memory consolidation — all without requiring user input.
How does the Substrate Agent Platform module integrate with other Jarvis modules?
Reads/writes all Jarvis memory JSON files. Triggers biomimetic simulations. Runs as Python subprocess from the main server.
What is the Knowledge Graph & Memory module?

The Knowledge Graph & Memory (id: knowledge) is one of Jarvis's core modules. It runs as a background system. Jarvis persists: core memory (user profile), episodic memory (64+ events), semantic graph (1,410 concepts, 99 relations), chat history (439+ messages), skills registry (9 skills), noospheric calibration state, biomimetic presets, and DNA behavioral parameters.
What data does Jarvis persist?

Jarvis persists: core memory (user profile), episodic memory (64+ events), semantic graph (1,410 concepts, 99 relations), chat history (439+ messages), skills registry (9 skills), noospheric calibration state, biomimetic presets, and DNA behavioral parameters.
Where are Jarvis's memory files?

All in the root directory: jarvis_core_memory.json, jarvis_episodic_memory.json, jarvis_semantic_graph.json, jarvis_chat_history.json, jarvis_skills.json, jarvis_biomimetic_presets.json, jarvis_noospheric_calibration.json, jarvis_core_memory.json.
How does the semantic graph work?

The semantic graph stores 1,410 concept nodes and 99 directional relations. Each node has an id, label, and type. Relations connect source→target with a label. New knowledge is added via POST /api/memory/add-relation. The graph is persisted to jarvis_semantic_graph.json.
How does the Knowledge Graph & Memory module integrate with other Jarvis modules?
All memory files are read/written by the Memory API, Substrate Platform, and Chat System.
The TRM swarm health endpoint is returning ECONNREFUSED. What's wrong and how do I fix it?

ECONNREFUSED means TRM is not accepting connections. The most likely cause is a Node.js IPv4/IPv6 mismatch: Node.js resolves 'localhost' to IPv6 ::1, but TRM's uvicorn binds only to IPv4 0.0.0.0. Fix: replace 'localhost:8021' with '127.0.0.1:8021' in all Jarvis fetch URLs. Also verify TRM is running with 'curl http://127.0.0.1:8021/health'. If TRM is down, restart it: 'python -m uvicorn swarm_v2.app_v2:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8021 --log-level warning'.
Jarvis can't reach the TRM mesh topology endpoint. What's the fallback?

The topology fetch has a 1000ms AbortController timeout. If the fetch times out or fails, Jarvis returns { nodes: [], error: 'Topology fetch failed' }. The mesh gracefully degrades — Jarvis retries on the next heartbeat cycle. Check: (1) TRM is running on 127.0.0.1:8021, (2) the URL uses 127.0.0.1 not localhost (IPv6 issue), (3) firewall isn't blocking port 8021.
Jarvis is returning 'Gemini API quota exhausted'. What happened and what's the solution?

The Google Gemini API free tier has a quota limit (requests per minute and tokens per day). When exceeded, Gemini returns 429 RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED. Jarvis catches this and returns: 'My apologies, Boss. It appears my core thinking matrix has exhausted the Gemini API's free request quota (429 Resource Exhausted) or rate limits. Standing by on standby power. Please check the secret API key credentials under the Environment Settings or try again shortly.' Solution: wait for quota reset, upgrade to paid tier, or check TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN / GEMINI_API_KEY in .env.
The Gemini API call failed. What's Jarvis's fallback behavior?

Jarvis has a fallback chain: first try gemini-3.5-flash, then gemini-3.1-flash-lite, then gemini-flash-latest. If ALL Gemini models fail, the runJarvisAgent function catches the error and logs '[Jarvis Fallback] Gemini call failed — routing to local gemma4:12b...'. It then calls Ollama at localhost:11434 with model 'gemma4:12b'. If Ollama also fails, it returns a generic apology.
Jarvis can't load core memory. What happens?

Memory loading has a try/catch with fallback to default state. If jarvis_core_memory.json doesn't exist or is corrupted, Jarvis returns: { user_profile: { name: 'Unknown User', alias: 'Boss' }, current_context: {} }. The error is logged but doesn't crash the server. The same pattern applies to episodic memory and semantic graph — each file loads independently with its own fallback.
The web analyzer can't resolve a domain. What errors can occur?

Multiple points of failure: (1) 400 — URL is missing or invalid. (2) DNS resolution failure — domain doesn't exist. (3) TLS handshake failure — certificate expired or invalid. (4) Connection timeout — server not responding. (5) HTTP error — server returns 4xx/5xx. Each is caught separately with specific error messages.
Telegram integration isn't working. What do I check?

Check in order: (1) POST /api/telegram/status returns polling state. (2) Bot token was configured via POST /api/telegram/config. (3) The Telegram uplink skill is enabled in skills registry. (4) The bot was actually started via BotFather on Telegram. (5) The bot has permission to send messages to the target chat. (6) Network can reach api.telegram.org.
VibeThinker consensus returns an error. What could be wrong?

VibeThinker calls Ollama at localhost:11434 with the configured model (default deepseek-r1:1.5b). Errors: (1) 400 — prompt is missing or empty. (2) Ollama not running — start with 'ollama serve'. (3) Model not found — pull it with 'ollama pull deepseek-r1:1.5b'. (4) Ollama overloaded — reduce numSamples from default 3. All trajectories are collected independently; one failure doesn't crash the whole consensus.
The TRM swarm pushed a DNA update but Jarvis isn't responding differently. Why?

The DNA config endpoint (POST /config/dna) accepts temperature, stochasticity, emotionalVector, mood, and curiosity parameters. These are stored in memory but may not affect chat output until the next CHAT request (not the DNA POST itself). The DNA values are read by the chat system to adjust generation parameters. Check: (1) TRM is POSTing to http://127.0.0.1:3000/config/dna (not localhost). (2) The payload matches expected schema.
Jarvis won't start — EADDRINUSE :::3000. What do I do?

Port 3000 is already in use. This happens when a previous tsx child process orphans. Find the PID with 'netstat -ano | grep :3000 | grep LISTEN'. Kill it with 'powershell -Command "Stop-Process -Id <PID> -Force"' (in bash: use taskkill via cmd). Then restart with 'npm run dev'. To prevent orphans, always kill the parent tsx process, not just the child node process.
I registered a new skill but Jarvis isn't using it. What's wrong?

POST /api/skills/add adds the skill to jarvis_skills.json, but the AI needs to be aware of it. Check: (1) The skill is enabled (POST /api/skills/toggle with skill ID). (2) The skill's description is clear enough for the AI to understand when to use it. (3) The skill appears in GET /api/skills output. (4) The chat system reloads skills on each request (not cached). Skills with ambiguous descriptions may be ignored by the AI.
Jarvis is running slow. How do I optimize?

Check GET /api/system-stats for CPU/memory usage. Optimizations: (1) Prune old episodic memories manually via the memory system. (2) Clear chat history with POST /api/chat-history/clear. (3) Reduce VibeThinker numSamples from 3 to 1. (4) Restart the server to clear any memory leaks. (5) Check if gemma4:12b fallback is consuming too much VRAM — the Ollama model uses GPU resources.
